stem: 金融机构在终止客户关系的过程中应采取哪些做法？(选择三项。)

options.A: 在终止过程中采用灵活的沟通方式，以适应不同客户的情况
options.B: 实施一套标准化的客户终止程序，其中包括风险评估和必要的文件记录
options.C: 在终止服务前，对客户的交易历史和记录进行最终审查，以处理任何未解决的问题
options.D: 保留终止流程的记录，包括决策理由以及与客户的任何通信
options.E: 仅在完成终止流程后才通知客户终止决定，以防止可能的争议

stem_en: Which practices should financial institutions (FIs) adopt for the process of terminating customer relationships? (Choose three.)

options_en.A: Using a flexible communication style during the termination process that adapts to different customer situations
options_en.B: Implementing a standardized procedure for customer termination that includes risk assessments and necessary documentation
options_en.C: Performing a final review of a customer's transaction history and records to address any unresolved issues prior to termination
options_en.D: Keeping records of the termination process, including the justification for the decision and any communications with the customer
options_en.E: Notifying the customer of the termination decision only after the termination process is complete to prevent possible disputes
